section.content: 本实用新型涉及基因检测技术领域，且公开了一种用于生物基因工程的基因检测设备，包括底板，所述底板的顶部前后两端均开设有第一滑槽，所述第一滑槽的内底壁活动连接有多个滚珠，所述底板的顶部右端中部固定有驱动箱，所述驱动箱的内部固定有驱动电机，所述驱动电机的输出端通过联轴器连接有丝杆，所述丝杆的左端贯穿驱动箱的左侧并通过轴承与驱动箱连接，所述丝杆的外侧左端螺纹连接有内螺纹套杆。该用于生物基因工程的基因检测设备，在需要对检测设备进行维修时，通过在驱动电机输出端上的丝杆左端设置有内螺纹套杆，以达到外壳移动自动化的目的，进而减小了工作人员的劳动强度。

The utility model relates to a gene detection technical field just discloses a gene detection equipment for biological gene engineering, comprising a base plate, first spout has all been seted up at both ends around the top of bottom plate, the interior diapire swing joint of first spout has a plurality of balls, the top right-hand member middle part of bottom plate is fixed with the drive case, the inside of drive case is fixed with driving motor, driving motor's output has the lead screw through the coupling joint, the left end of lead screw runs through the left side of drive case and is connected with the drive case through the bearing, the outside left end threaded connection of lead screw has the internal thread loop bar. This a gene check out test set for biological genetic engineering when needs maintain check out test set, is provided with the internal thread loop bar through the lead screw left end on the driving motor output to reach the automatic purpose of shell removal, and then reduced staff's intensity of labour.

Gene detection equipment for biological gene engineeringTechnical Field

The utility model relates to a gene detection technical field specifically is a gene detection equipment for biological genetic engineering.

Background

The written product gene detection equipment is a technology for detecting DNA through blood, other body fluids or cells; the gene testing device of the newly disclosed existing product for biological gene engineering is a device that can move the housing.

Above-mentioned current product gene testing equipment is when needing to maintain testing equipment, and the casing is difficult to be dismantled, brings the trouble for the maintenance of equipment, and secondly to this kind of equipment to time requirement stricter of gene testing, it is better that the time of obviously dismantling is faster, and the maintenance time is slow, has the shortcoming that has certain influence to the experimental result.

To the above disadvantage, the chinese authorized utility model discloses a number: CN210419914U discloses a gene detection device for biological gene engineering, which solves the above disadvantages by providing a supporting leg, a pulley and a damping spring at the bottom of the housing;

however, the structural design of the prior art needs to manually move the shell when the detection device is maintained, so that the automation cannot be realized, and the labor intensity of workers is easily increased.

SUMMERY OF THE UTILITY MODEL

Technical problem to be solved

To the not enough of prior art in the above-mentioned background art, the utility model provides a gene detection equipment for biological genetic engineering to overcome the current gene detection equipment for biological genetic engineering who provides in the above-mentioned background art, when maintaining detection equipment, need the manual movement casing, can't realize automaticly, have the shortcoming that increases staff intensity of labour easily.

(II) technical scheme

In order to achieve the above purpose, the utility model discloses a following technical scheme realizes:

a gene detection device for biological gene engineering comprises a bottom plate, wherein first chutes are formed in the front end and the rear end of the top of the bottom plate, a plurality of balls are movably connected to the inner bottom wall of each first chute, a driving box is fixed to the middle of the right end of the top of the bottom plate, a driving motor is fixed inside the driving box, the output end of the driving motor is connected with a lead screw through a coupling, the left end of the lead screw penetrates through the left side of the driving box and is connected with the driving box through a bearing, an internal thread loop bar is in threaded connection with the left end of the outer side of the lead screw, a shell is connected to the left end of the internal thread loop bar through a bearing, a top cover is movably connected to the top of the shell through a hinge, a fixing plate is fixed to the left end of the top of the bottom plate, the right side of the fixing plate and the left side of the shell are spliced, positioning plates are fixed to the front end and the rear end of the left side of the shell, and rear ends of the fixing plate are fixed with sleeve plates, the left end of the positioning plate is inserted into the sleeve plate;

the detection device comprises a shell, a first sliding chute, a second sliding chute, sliding rods, a detector and a support frame, wherein the first sliding chute is arranged on the inner side of the shell, the second sliding chute is arranged on the inner side of the first sliding chute, sliding plates are fixed at the front end and the rear end of the bottom of the shell, the sliding plates are connected with the first sliding chute in a sliding mode, the bottom of each sliding plate is in contact with the top of a ball, the sliding rods are fixed on the front side and the rear side of each sliding plate, one end of each sliding rod is connected with the second sliding chute in a sliding mode, the detector and the support frame are arranged inside the shell, and the bottoms of the detector and the support frame are fixed to the top of a bottom plate.

As an optimal technical solution of the utility model: both ends all are fixed with the locating plate around the left side of shell, both sides all are fixed with the lagging around the fixed plate, the left end of locating plate is pegged graft with the inside of lagging, make the fixed plate can be better fix a position the shell.

As an optimal technical solution of the utility model: a plurality of heat dissipation holes are formed in the right side of the driving box, and dust covers are fixed inside the heat dissipation holes, so that the driving box can better dissipate heat and prevent dust for the driving motor.

Furthermore, a handle is fixed to the top of the top cover, and anti-skidding threads are arranged on the outer surface of the handle.

Furthermore, the locating plate is in an isosceles trapezoid shape, and the locating plate is matched with the sleeve plate.

Furthermore, the second sliding groove is composed of a square groove and a circular groove, and the sliding rod is matched with the second sliding groove.

Furthermore, the support frame is in an inverted U shape, and the detector is positioned on the inner side of the support frame.

Furthermore, a gene probe is fixed at the top of the detector, and a conveying pipe is fixed in the middle of the top surface of the support frame.

The working principle is that when the detection equipment is maintained, a driving motor is started, an internal thread loop bar is driven by a lead screw to move rightwards, a shell is pulled to move rightwards, meanwhile, a sliding plate at the bottom of the shell moves rightwards in a first sliding groove, balls on the bottom wall in the first sliding groove transmit the sliding plate, sliding rods on the front side and the rear side of the sliding plate move rightwards in a second sliding groove, a fixed plate is separated from the shell firstly in the moving process of the shell, the detection equipment in the shell is gradually exposed in the air, and after the detection equipment is completely separated from the shell, the driving motor is closed, the shell is stopped from moving, and the detection equipment is maintained.

The electrical components presented in the document are all electrically connected with an external master controller and 220V mains, and the master controller can be a conventional known device controlled by a computer or the like.

(III) advantageous effects

The utility model provides a gene detection equipment for biological genetic engineering possesses following beneficial effect:

(1) this a gene check out test set for biological genetic engineering when needs maintain check out test set, is provided with the internal thread loop bar through the lead screw left end on the driving motor output to reach the automatic purpose of shell removal, and then reduced staff's intensity of labour.

(2) This a gene check out test set for biological gene engineering, both ends are provided with locating plate and lagging respectively around through both ends and fixed plate around the shell is left, the purpose of fixing a position has been reached to the shell, surface through at the handle is provided with anti-skidding screw thread, frictional force between staff's palm and the handle has been increased, so that the staff is to the opening and closing operation of top cap, be provided with a plurality of louvres through the right side at the drive box, and be provided with the dust cover in the inside of louvre, the purpose of dispelling the heat and preventing dust to driving motor has been reached.
